newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan's Hotung offers 242.4 million shares in IPO.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan's Hotung offers 242.4 million shares in IPO.

text.p: Taiwan's Hotung Investment Holdings Ltd said on Monday it was offering a total of 242.4 million shares at US$0.26 each in its Singapore initial public offer.
The offer comprises a placement tranche 193.9 million shares and a public tranche of 48.5 million shares.
The company is raising net proceeds of about US$41.86 million or NT$1,151 million.

It will use US$25.45 million for a proposed new fund to be incorporated in the British Virgin Islands. It will use US$12.98 million for the subscription of 51 percent of a securities underwriting business and an investment trust business.
The remainder will be used to repay a bridging facility and for working capital.
The shares are offered at a price earnings ratio of 18.4 times based on its earnings for the financial year ended December 31, 1996.
The company recorded a net profit of NT$309.2 million on an operating revenue of NT$514.3 million in 1996.
Application for the shares to be quoted on the mainboard of the Stock Exchange of Singapore will close on August 7 and start trading on on August 11.
